options.name: auth_password
options.description: Set the authentication password for the V3 trap. The password is a string of 8 to 16 alphanumeric characters. Required when I(auth_protocol) is either C(SHA) or C(MD5).

options.name: auth_protocol
options.description: Choose the authentication protocol for the V3 trap.

options.name: community
options.description: Community of v1/v2c.

options.name: contact
options.description: Set the contact, can be NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: engine_id
options.description: Specifies an engine identifier for the V3 trap. The value should be string of 10 to 48 hex characters, must be even, can be NULL.

options.name: event_severity
options.description: Event Severity.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: host_id
options.description: Host id. Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: location
options.description: Set the host location, can be NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: os
options.description: Set the host operating system, can be NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: priv_password
options.description: Set the privacy password for the V3 trap. The password is a string of 8 to 16 alphanumeric characters. Required when I(priv_protocol) is either C(DES) or C(AES).

options.name: priv_protocol
options.description: Choose the privacy protocol for the V3 trap.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: system_id
options.description: Set the system ID, can be NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: system_name
options.description: Set the system name, can be NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: trap_port
options.description: Set a port for the SNMP trap in the range of 1 to 65535. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: v3username
options.description: Set the username for the V3 trap.

options.name: version
options.description: SNMP trap version, 1 is v1, 2 is v2c(v2), 3 is v3, 0 is disable snmp trap. Only the M6 model supports C(0) Settings.
